sentences.text: 2. The brief facts of the case are as follows:
One Mrs.Santhanalakshmi (de facto complainant herein) has two sons viz., Raja Edwin and Ravi Edwin.
The de facto complainants first son Raja Edwin had married the Appellant/P.W.1 and he was working as a Software Engineer at Saudi Arabia.
The de facto complainants second son Ravi Edwin had married the 2nd Respondent/Accused and he was living in India. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis
The 2nd Respondent/Accused had already married one Mr.Umamaheswara Rao and had a daughter viz., Bhavana.
The 2 nd Respondent/Accused got divorce from her 1st husband and thereafter, she married the de facto complainants second son Ravi Edwin.
The de facto complainants second son Ravi Edwin and 2nd Respondent/Accused had a daughter viz., Raji Edwin.
While so, on 09.12.2009, the de facto complainants second son Ravi Edwin had died in a road accident.

After the demise of Ravi Edwin, her wife 2nd Respondent/Accused had filed a Claim Petition in M.C.O.P.No.1266 of 2010 before the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Chennai claiming a sum of Rs.26,00,000/- as compensation for the death of her husband Ravi Edwin.
In the said Claim Petition, 2 nd Respondent/Accused had included herself and her two daughters as claimants 1 to 3 and she had also included the de facto complainant as 4th claimant.
